generation: Built-in ImageGen edit of actual headless Blender renders

outline.measurement: Distance from opaque artwork to the 50% alpha boundary

portraits.name: Honey Bee
portraits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. A single transparent Roblox simulator inventory icon. Edit Image 1, an actual Blender render of Honey Bee. Lock its front-left three-quarter view, soft rounded-square body, exact features, proportions, and warm saturated plastic shading. Bright golden-yellow cube bee with two dark caramel bands across the body, two golden round-tipped dark antennae, exactly two pale ivory wings angled upward behind them, glossy amber eyes and tiny dark caramel paws. Image 2 is only the outline thickness reference. Add a single smooth and very thick, uniform pure-black exterior outline like that reference, about 48 pixels on a 1024 square. Center the complete character with even transparent padding and preserve negative spaces. Actual transparent RGBA outside the black contour, no text, no floor or shadow, no bloom outside the silhouette, no backdrop and no extra decorations.
